snapshot.text: Wizz Air, the low-cost carrier operating an all-Airbus narrowbody fleet, saw its EBITDA margin narrow by {{ebitda_margin.change@FY2025}} to {{ebitda_margin@FY2025}} in FY2025, a year in which a manufacturer engine recall forced a large part of the fleet to be grounded at any time.

The point to watch is leverage against the peer group: net leverage of {{net_leverage@FY2025}} compares with a peer median of {{net_leverage.peer_median@FY2025}}, and Fitch downgraded the company citing higher leverage and increased costs.
